title: The family picture
lede: What the family owns, what it's worth, and what's owed on it, so Nicholas can build one true net worth number. Rough numbers and ranges are fine, in any order, over as many sittings as you like. Never type an account number, password, or Social Security number here: say "in person" and tell him. Everything you type saves to Nicholas by itself a few seconds after you stop typing.
